card.name: Verbs about stuff leaking, leftover or discarded
card.fires_on: A verb or particle right after a thing or place, describing material escaping, remaining, being thrown out or removed (allowed, left, away, remaining, sent). It appears in both web prose and label instructions.

modes.label: Escape or leakage
modes.description: Verb saying gases or matter got out or were sent out from a source.
modes.example: a hole on the left wing<< allowed>> atmospheric gases to bleed into the shuttle as

modes.label: Leftover or discarded
modes.description: Word saying something remains in a container or is thrown away.
modes.example: There may be medication<< left>> in the bottle; however, the bottle

modes.label: Survive or remain
modes.description: Verb saying granules or items remain or survive after an action.
modes.example: this may result in granules<< remaining>> in the capsule.

card.writes: It nudges the output toward words of leftover, waste or scarcity and away from words like excess, surplus and unwanted.
card.plain: It fires on verbs about material being left over, escaping or thrown away.
